Meg voted to exile Hoang. Reason: Hoang's immediate claim to be the Seer is far too aggressive and feels like a calculated move to manipulate our trust. He's trying to dictate the narrative from the start. We can't risk letting a fake Seer lead us into a trap.

night_actions: Cong (Witch) did not use any potions.

day_debate.speaker: Nhan
day_debate.statement: Nam's frantic accusations against Meg, coupled with his previous targeting of me, are textbook wolf behavior. He's creating chaos and attempting to deflect suspicion. I vote Nam.

He's trying to hijack the conversation with manufactured theories because he has nothing else. Nam, your panic is showing. It's time we stop letting you dictate the narrative. I vote Nam.
